{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QKJX2PBaRd6FszHL59yYFq","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport unittest\n2\t\n3\tfrom ewallet.wallet import EWallet\n4\t\n5\t\n6\tclass TestWithdraw(unittest.TestCase):\n7\t    def test_valid_withdrawal_deducts_amount(self):\n8\t        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)\n9\t        self.assertTrue(wallet.withdraw(30))\n10\t        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 70)\n11\t\n12\t    def test_withdrawal_exceeding_balance_rejected(self):\n13\t        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)\n14\t        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(150))\n15\t        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)\n16\t\n17\t    def test_exact_balance_withdrawal_rejected(self):\n18\t        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)\n19\t        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(100))\n20\t        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)\n21\t\n22\t    def test_zero_withdrawal_rejected(self):\n23\t        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)\n24\t        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(0))\n25\t        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)\n26\t\n27\t    def test_negative_withdrawal_rejected(self):\n28\t        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)\n29\t        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(-10))\n30\t        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)\n31\t\n32\t    def
